summary: All 3 tests failed in the Product Overview suite. Failures are due to missing elements, zero product cards found, and a test timeout while waiting for product name element.
rootCause: The tests failed because the expected elements identified by data-testid selectors were not found or visible on the page, indicating that selectors may not match the current application DOM or the page did not load expected content.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify grid of product cards is displayed on home page
failedTests.errorMessage: expect(locator('[data-testid="product-grid"]')).toBeVisible() failed: element(s) not found within 5000ms timeout.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' did not match any element on the page, possibly due to UI changes or page not loading expected content.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector '[data-testid="product-grid"]' is correct and that the page loads the product grid element. Update selector if UI changed or add waits to ensure page content is loaded.

failedTests.testName: TC-002 - Verify product card details are displayed
failedTests.likelyCause: No product cards were found on the page, likely because the product grid or cards are missing or selectors do not match current DOM.
failedTests.recommendation: Check if product cards are rendered on the page and selectors are accurate. Investigate if the application is serving correct data or if test data is missing.

failedTests.testName: TC-003 - Verify navigation to product detail page from product card
failedTests.errorMessage: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for locator('[data-testid="product-card"]').first().locator('[data-testid="product-name"]').innerText()
failedTests.likelyCause: The product card or product name element was not found or did not appear within the timeout, possibly due to missing elements or slow page load.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify the presence of product cards and product name elements. Consider increasing timeout or adding explicit waits. Confirm selectors are correct and application is responsive.

recommendations: Validate and update selectors used in tests to match current application DOM.
Ensure the application under test is serving expected content and data during test execution.
Add or improve waits to handle asynchronous page loading.
Investigate if recent application changes affected UI elements targeted by tests.
Check environment stability and network conditions to rule out loading issues.
releaseImpact: High - All tests in the Product Overview suite failed, blocking validation of critical UI components and navigation flows.
